searchText: My attempt to explain Rewards and Penalties on Ethereum 2.0 [Phase 0] https://codefi.consensys.net/blog/rewards-and-penalties-on-ethereum-20-phase-0 it'll be super interesting to see how often slashing penalties get applied > it'll be super interesting to see how often slashing penalties get applied <@!680234424037670912> We can model one probability of a validator "being honest", and other for "whistleblowing sucess". The thing is getting the data... Would the testnets be a good source? I have no idea what a good source would be at this point 😦 it just seems that the penalties are *huge* so more than 1 validator getting slashed every 12 epochs and you're generating effectively 0 eth? or losing eth? I can think of three causes of slashing: 1) individual validator failure (e.g. double voting due to misconfigured HA setup) 2) client failure (i.e. bug in prysm/lighthouse/whatever) 3) attack I suspect we'll see a spate of 1), and none of 3). Hoping we never see 2), but that's the one with the biggest combined (probability * impact). with 2 it'd be interesting to see the litigation that came out :/ i completely agree that it wouldnt make financial sense to use this as an attack vector

I can think of three causes of slashing:
  1) individual validator failure (e.g. double voting due to misconfigured HA setup)
  2) client failure (i.e. bug in prysm/lighthouse/whatever)
  3) attack

I suspect we'll see a spate of 1), and none of 3).  Hoping we never see 2), but that's the one with the biggest combined (probability * impact).
